Class ReportExporter

java.lang.Object
com.example.export.ReportExporter
Direct Known Subclasses:
JsonReportExporter, PdfReportExporter
public abstract class ReportExporter extends Object
export(SessionInfo, List, File) fixes the steps for saving a report (work out the file name, then write the file), and each subclass supplies only the format-specific parts: extension() and write(SessionInfo, List, File).

    • export

      public final File export(SessionInfo session, List<TelemetryEvent> events, File folder) throws IOException
      The template method: saves the session's report into a folder. It is final so subclasses cannot change the order of the steps.
      Parameters:
      session - the session's details
      events - the session's events
      folder - the folder to save into (the BlueJ project's folder)
      Returns:
      the file that was written
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be written
